content: Yaubada ina lovina yawou
E tomotayadi Yaubada ilatuwokoidi ame nakae, idigo kana,
‘Yau Yauwe imi Yaubada da Itipita idi kasa goi akalaoduwemi. Boi komi da Itipita idi pakonayao go, Yau ataligeimi.
Tauna taabu basaleliuyao goi kokaatuvēkwana matagu goi.
Taabu tokwalu koomadāgi bego dogoi tayamo yábana goi o poyapoya yatana goi o négwasa sinaena goi ana tapata nakae bego imi basaleliu.

Basaleliuyaoyadi yaidi taabu kovaatugūyala kokanakabobo be taabu kosaakulūlu yaidi. Yau Yauwe imi Yaubada moe Tovakavavágana vakookoligu. Avatau neta nakae iguinuwe moe ikaolilivegu, tauna tauna bei aliune go, niga neta natunao be tubunao ina tapepeko sivatotowone, tauyadi nakae bei aliunedi.
Go avatauwa neta simatakooiyegu be nakae guna lovina sikabikaaonedi, e amo tauyadi be nakae mlidi idi bodao badabadaidi simamaima yaidi goi alokatedi.
Taabu Yau Yauwe imi Yaubada yoigu kokaigoyāi. Avatau neta yoigu ikaigoyai, amo tauyana bei aliune.
Maliyalina aba waiwasi konuwookavāte kokimasābe umagu.
Maliyalina ainima tayamo goi koopaisēwa be imi paisewa madabokidi koguuinuwēdi.

Go maliyalina ainima aiyuwoina moe aba waiwasi Yau Yauwe imi Yaubada umagu. Amo maliyalinayana goi taabu koopaisēwa; komi, natumiyao, imi pakonayao koroto be vevina, imi bulumakauyao be nakae tomalatonikasa yaimi sikaaiyaka, paisewa geya.

Maliyalina ainima tayamo goi Yau Yauwe yábana be poyapoya be négwasa be nakae kaga liliuna sinaedi amadagidi go, maliyalina ainima aiyuwoina goi awaiwasi. Tauna maliyalina ainima aiyuwoina aba waiwasi Yau Yauwe bogina akaipakuye be nakae akimasabe umagu.
Tamamiyao be sinamiyao kowowooinēdi, e bei yawoimi simamanao poyapoya Yau Yauwe imi Yaubada bei aavinimi goi.
Taabu kokaaumāta.
Taabu korooerāta.
Taabu kovaaināwana.
Taabu kotalavaita poolapōla semiyao yaidi.
Semiyao idi vada be monediyao be idi pakonayao koroto o vevina be idi bulumakauyao o idi aseyao o ava kónana tayamo taabu koyaalagāudi.’
Isileli tubunao Yauwe simaatoite tetelina
E kidi go tomotayadi palapala sinovenove be ávila sigitegite, nakae síula sinovenove be aubowo sigitegite, tuwo wowodi sitatátava go, sibala sina masigava goi siitáoya.
Tuwo silatuwokoigu sidigo kadi, ‘Kom toinim kuvadigōima bei kanovem. Go taabu Yaubada ivaadigōima, govila bei kakámasa.’
Go yau adigo kagu, ‘Taabu koomatōita! Yaubada ima bego Tauyana koyagoidoko, e bei kowowoinevatae be nakae goyo geya koguinuweyeta.’
Tuwo tomotayadi masigava goi siitáoya go, yau ana gaota kalaabadaina kikina goi atáoya. Gaotayana sinaena moe Yaubada ikaaiyaka.
Yauwe ina kanasíuna bukina
Lovina aba kasala manuna
E Yauwe ilatuwokoigu idigo kana, ‘Ame nakae Isileli tubunao kulatuwokōidi, kudīgo kam, “Komi toinimi bogina konove bego yábana goi avadigoimi. Geya kogiteguta, go sem konovegumo.
Tauna geya tayaamo basaleliu ana tokwalu siriba goi o goura goi koomadāgi bego dogoiyana be Yau taiyao kavavasa, e yaima kosakululu geya.

Go sem guna kaba kasala poyapoya goi komadāgi. Aba kasalayana goi imi yoguyoguyao moe imi sipiyao nakae imi bulumakauyao kokasalēdi yaigu. Yoguyoguyadi maniyedi bei kovakasavēdi go, maniyedi abivekoveko manuna kogabudīmo kokāika. Ava kasava goi neta atagona komi kosakululu yaigu, e amo asayadi liliudi goi bei awokoimi, e akaipakuyemi.
Go aba kasala gurewa goi neta kokaudakodako, taabu gurewayadi kokauvisivisīdi. Neta turu goi kokauvisivisidi, e gurewayadi bogina kokibaibailidi sakululu yaigu manuna.
Taabu aba kasalayana manuna aitámana koomadāgi, govila bei komwera, e bisosoimi sobuyekoidi moe aba kasalayana ikaaiyaka,
e bei sikibaibāili.”’

footnotes.text: Bisosoimi sobuyekoidi moe aba kasalayana ikaaiyaka: Tonúwala adi kwama seti maanawena nakae go, sinaena tarausisi geya silosiyeta, tauna neta aitámana simwera, aba kasala yatana goi bei sitáoya, bisosoidi sobuyekoidi aba kasalayana ikaaiyaka go, geya tayaamo kaga bisosoidi ivatumdi, tauna aba kasalayana sikibaibaili.
